title: Asparagus, ricotta and fried egg on toast

grandparents_cupboard.reason: Asparagus, ricotta, eggs, butter, bread, lemon and chives are all plain whole foods with nothing factory-made.

supermarket.reason: Every item is a Tesco staple, and British asparagus is an everyday buy in June rather than a specialist item.

basic_kitchen.reason: It needs only a frying pan, a bowl and a toaster, and frying asparagus and eggs is well within a beginner's skills.

works.reason: The quantities suit four (100g asparagus, an egg and a slice each), and the asparagus timing and the ricotta seasoning are sound.

honest_times.reason: Twenty-five minutes in total is believable for snapping the asparagus, mixing the ricotta, frying the asparagus and four eggs, and toasting the bread.

honest_ingredients.reason: Every listed ingredient and seasoning is used, the lemon for zest and juice, and nothing unlisted appears in the steps.

seasonal_feel.reason: A light asparagus breakfast suits late June, the tail end of the British asparagus season, and the asparagus is clearly the point of the dish.

plain_voice.reason: The steps are short, clear British English with no restaurant language or preaching.

hearty_healthy.reason: Egg, ricotta and a good pile of vegetables on toast is a proper breakfast a family would want again.
